scheme: Three digits, each 0-9, counting up like an odometer: 1.0.0, 1.0.1 ... 1.0.9, then 1.1.0 ... 1.9.9, then 2.0.0. Every change bumps the last digit.

entries.title: Settings: Users tab first
changes: The Users tab is now the first tab in Settings (admins only, as before)

entries.title: Upcoming Drops: remove a manually added concept
changes: Trash button on manually added concepts only (Playbook concepts stay fixed), with a confirmation
Removal archives the concept through the concept lifecycle: history kept and restorable, published concepts protected

entries.title: Upcoming Drops product page: options menu no longer cut off
changes: The ··· menu on the last concept row (for example a newly added concept) is no longer clipped by the table

entries.title: Drop page: completed product cards turn light green
changes: A product card whose coverage is complete (COVERAGE COMPLETE) is tinted light green

entries.title: Upcoming Drops product page: progress bar now fills and updates
changes: The header progress bar fill was an inline element and never showed; it is now a block and moves with the completed-creatives count

entries.title: Upcoming Drops cards: whole pictures on grey tiles; picture proxy recovers after a hiccup
changes: Drop card product pictures show the whole front and back view on a light grey tile, left-aligned names
A failed ApparelMagic lookup in the picture proxy is retried after 15 seconds, and a failed measurement is retried in the browser

entries.title: Upcoming Drops: completed concept rows turn green
changes: A concept with Filmed, Edited and Uploaded to Meta all ticked gets a green-tinted row with a green edge and solid green ticks

entries.title: Upcoming Drops: Playbook-driven Reference and Assigned To, no Edit button
changes: Creative Playbook entries get a Reference link and a Default assigned to
Upcoming Drop concepts show the Playbook reference and take the Playbook person when unassigned; hand-picked assignments are never changed
Edit button and the drop-page Add reference removed

entries.title: Upcoming Drops: simpler imagery and Filmed / Edited / Uploaded checkboxes
changes: One combined product image; no repeated thumbnails in the header, colourway panel or concept rows
Production Status timeline replaced by Filmed, Edited and Uploaded to Meta checkboxes that save on click
Checkboxes read and write the existing asset status, so Shooting, Editing, Final Approval and the Board stay consistent

entries.title: Upcoming Drops product detail redesign
changes: Product header with progress chips and a slim completed-vs-required bar
Compact Concept | Reference | Assigned To | Production Status | Action table replaces the large concept rows and stacked checkboxes
Production stage read from the existing Shooting, Editing, Final Approval and Meta upload data
Reference from the Creative Playbook entry, with View video / View example and Add reference
Other Creative Concepts collapsed with a count

entries.title: Meta Mapping: search for the product
changes: Each unmapped Meta combination now has a search box instead of the long product dropdown: type any part of a product name or code and pick from the matching, highlighted results
With nothing typed it suggests the products closest to the Meta product name; arrow keys and Enter work, and Map saves the chosen product exactly as before

entries.title: Settings: one Meta section
changes: Meta Performance (the default), Meta Sync and Meta Mapping are now one Meta tab in Settings, with toggles between the three views
Admin-only views stay admin-only; each view keeps its own panel, loader and save behaviour

entries.title: Remove Angus, Jake and Ronit
changes: Angus, Jake and Ronit are deactivated once on deploy (not deleted, so their history is kept): they can no longer log in and drop out of the user lists and Module Access
They are no longer part of the built-in seed list; a later manual re-activation is never undone

entries.title: High Stocks: Other products header more noticeable
changes: The Other High Stock Products accordion is larger: taller header, bigger heading and chevron, a firmer border and a Show products / Hide control on the right

entries.title: High Stocks: Other High Stock Products accordion
changes: The Almost qualifying section is now Other High Stock Products (N): a compact accordion, collapsed by default, with a short helper line

When opened it shows the existing product table with the Creative Status column renamed Why Not Recommended, only the engine's short explanation (no repeated Not Recommended badge), and Add to Shoot kept as a secondary action
UI only: no recommendation, threshold, sorting or action changed

entries.title: Creative Insights redesign
changes: Creative Insights now opens with three summary cards (Established Winners, Promising Concepts, Concepts Analysed), a spend-coverage indicator, and the benchmark explanation moved into a How concepts are rated info section
A compact four-column concept table: Concept, Tested, Performance (colour badge with the relevant funnel CPA) and Next opportunity; the performance filter and search are unchanged
The expanded concept shows a short data-generated explanation, TOM / TOF / MOF performance cards for the funnels that have data, Products tested and Where to test next with + Shoot

All technical detail (funnel breakdown, benchmark criteria, Met / Not met, individual creatives with Meta links, ad names and IDs) is in a collapsed Detailed Performance & Creative Evidence section; no rating, threshold or recommendation changed

entries.title: High Stocks: Almost qualifying section
changes: High Stocks now lists up to 10 products in all: the recommendations as before, then an Almost qualifying section with the next closest Platinum / Rocket products that narrowly missed one rule (each says which), with Add to Shoot available
No rule, threshold, score or recommendation changed; the section shows results the engine already returns

entries.title: Core Catalogue: add any product to the Shoot Plan
changes: Covered and not-recommended products in the Core Catalogue now have a quiet outline + Shoot (they had only View), so any product can be added by hand; the shoot form still asks before using a restricted colourway
Products that cannot be planned (not launched, launch not confirmed, past weeks) keep a plain View

entries.title: Core Catalogue: category top level restored
changes: The Core Catalogue opens on the category view again: one row per category with last 7 days' sales, last year vs this year month-to-date, how many products need creative, creative freshness and what is selected this week
Opening a category lists its products as the new five-column rows, which still expand to the full product view
Priority remains as a flat list; search and the filters open the categories that have matches

entries.title: Core Catalogue expanded product view
changes: Expanding a Core Catalogue product now shows the Creative Opportunities layout: large picture with colourway thumbnails, a recommendation banner only for products that need creative, and Sales (7D), Inventory and Creative Performance cards
Selectable colourway cards (ready to shoot, out of stock, sizes) reuse the Creative Opportunities selection: ticked colourways go into the Shoot Plan as one product record
Less important information (previous 7 days, monthly and yearly comparisons, velocity, creative history) moved into a collapsed More details, with a View Meta Ads link
No calculation or recommendation changed; the Creative Performance card is now one shared component

entries.title: Core Product Catalogue redesign
changes: The Core Catalogue tab is now one clean list with five columns: Product, Sales (7D), Stock, Creative Status and Action
Colourways of one product are grouped into one row; each row expands to sales history, inventory and on order, creative history and freshness, Meta ads, colourways and planning actions
Creative Status shows one soft badge and one short line from the existing recommendation results; Action is a black + Shoot, ✓ Shooting, or a quiet View for covered products
Search, Priority / By Category and All Products / Needs Attention / In Production filters; the old category table and View All Core Products list are replaced
Sales (7D) % change is exact (the server now also sends the previous 7 days' units); no recommendation or calculation changed

entries.title: Final Core Shoot Planning refinements
changes: Red dot removed from product names; products sharing a name show their colourway (for example OFFEND BEACH SHORT - BLACK), or the real product code when colours do not tell them apart
Category Creative Freshness shows an amber N Unassessed badge with 'X of Y products assessed' when coverage is incomplete; Up to Date only when every product is assessed and none needs refreshing
Display only: calculations, recommendations and integrations unchanged

entries.title: Core Shoot Planning product rows
changes: Product picture next to every product name, with the attention dot, and a Product column header
Creative Attention: status and priority on one line with one supporting sentence (for example 0 of 2 active ads performing); the repeated Active Ads line is removed
Creative Freshness: age of the newest creative first, a Recent / Ageing / Needs refresh / Not assessed indicator, the creative date underneath
A selected product no longer tints its row; the Shooting indicator says it. Display only: all calculations unchanged

entries.title: Last-year MTD tile label
changes: The last-year MTD tile in Core Shoot Planning now shows its month (for example OCT 25)
The tile and the month tiles share one height and top edge

entries.title: Creative Freshness wording
changes: Creative Freshness badges now read Up to Date, N Need Refresh and Not Assessed (Stale is replaced by Need Refresh, including the product chip)
Supporting line states what is measured: Latest creative, Oldest product, or N of M products assessed
Display only: freshness calculation, thresholds and recommendations are unchanged

entries.title: Core Shoot Planning badges
changes: Creative Attention shows a red N need creative or green Covered badge, with awaiting review as muted text underneath
Creative Freshness shows amber N stale (with Oldest: N days ago) or green Up to date (with Latest: N days ago); neutral Not assessed when there is not enough data
This Week's Shoot shows a green N Selected badge or a grey dash
Display only: existing counts, thresholds and Shoot Plan data are unchanged

entries.title: Subtler past creatives line
changes: Creative Performance card footer now reads N past creatives, in smaller, lighter grey text

entries.title: Creative Performance card display logic
changes: No active creative now reads No Active Creative / No ads currently running for this product, never 0 of 0
With active creatives the card lists only non-zero categories: underperforming (subtle red) and awaiting data (muted grey), using the engine's existing per-creative classification
Creatives without an approved benchmark, still testing or with too little delivery are awaiting data, never underperforming

entries.title: Clearer Creative Performance card
changes: Core product card now reads 1 of 9 with Active creatives performing, a not-performing line and N previous creatives tested
Not performing is red only when creatives are judged over the approved limit; testing and unrated stay neutral

entries.title: Always show creative history
changes: The creatives card always shows its history line when known: No earlier creatives, or N earlier creatives, with the all-time total

entries.title: Earlier creatives on the Core product card
changes: The creatives card shows how many earlier unique creatives a product has had and the all-time total (hidden when there is no history)
The card label now says On active ads / effective, since it counts creatives on active ads

entries.title: Remove duplicate Add to Shoot
changes: The expanded product view no longer repeats the Add to Shoot button already on the row (More options stays)

entries.title: Revert Core Planning redesign
changes: Creative Opportunities, the Core Catalogue and the Shoot Plan strip are back to their v1.4.6 layout
The redesign (v1.4.7) is removed; engine, scoring, benchmarks and data are unchanged

entries.title: Core Planning redesign
changes: Compact Shoot Plan strip replaces the large banner
Creative Opportunities table: no rank column, Creative Coverage (active / effective / latest), Creative Gap badge, subtle Priority
One shared product detail (Overview, Creative Performance, Shoot Readiness) for Creative Opportunities, High Stocks and the Core Catalogue
Core Catalogue: simpler category rows, monthly sales inside the expanded category, same product table, selection stays in sync with Opportunities
Presentation only: engine, scoring, benchmarks and Shoot Plan logic unchanged

entries.title: AI Copy Assistant: Claude and OpenAI side by side
changes: Ad Setup > Primary Text can generate with Claude (default) or OpenAI, or both at once, and show the two sets side by side with provider and model recorded
OpenAI default model is gpt-6.1-sol (Responses API, reasoning effort low, structured JSON output, store false); OPENAI_COPY_MODEL overrides it
Both providers receive identical Copy Library references, Copy Type, verified product facts and safeguards; nothing is selected or approved automatically
Additive database column ad_copy_generations.provider; earlier generations count as Claude

entries.title: AI Copy Assistant: automatic Copy Type, better references, product-claim safeguards
changes: The assistant works out the Copy Type (Core, New Range, New Colourways, Bundle, USA Bundle, Sale, or General) from information the pipeline already holds, shows why, and lets you override it; the override is saved on the Ad Setup and can be reset to automatic.

Reference examples now come from the right spreadsheet tabs for the Copy Type, matched by whole words and product type, without recruitment ads or near-duplicates; the sheet's What column is used as the product.

Past ads only shape tone and structure: other products' details are removed before the AI sees them, and claims such as fits, colourway counts, features, fabric, popularity or launch wording are rejected unless the app holds the fact.
Settings > Copy Library has a Check before refreshing report, and a refresh that would shrink the library sharply is rejected.

entries.title: AI Copy Assistant: fixed the HTTP 400 on Generate Copy
changes: Primary Text requests no longer send a temperature setting, which the current Claude model rejects with HTTP 400.
The AI answer limit now leaves room for the model's thinking, so answers are not cut off.
If the AI provider rejects a request, the app shows a short reference (status, error type, request id) and records the details, without any credentials, in the server log.

entries.title: Planning thumbnails: slightly tilted garments are levelled
changes: In the small product thumbnails (Planning tray, Shoot Plan tiles, Upcoming Drops), a catalogue picture that is a degree or two off level is drawn level. The tilt is estimated from the garment's own symmetry and corrected only when it is small (up to 5 degrees) and clearly better; level pictures, large tilts and unclear pictures are left exactly as they were. The large preview is never rotated.

entries.title: Core planning: one tab bar (Creative Opportunities | Core Catalogue)
changes: The Core page now has a single tab bar to swap between Creative Opportunities and the Core Catalogue (every category and product), replacing the two stacked sections and the dropdown. Only the selected view shows; each tab carries a count; the choice is remembered for the session and the tabs work with the keyboard.

entries.title: Core catalogue: Creative Attention and Freshness match the Core table; more prominent panel
changes: Core Shoot Planning (Browse the full Core catalogue): Creative Attention and Creative Freshness now use the same results as the Core table above. Categories show how many products need creative attention (with High priority and needs-review counts) and how many are stale; expanded products show the table's own status, priority, Active Ads, and the latest creative date with how long ago and a Recent / Ageing / Stale band, using the Planning settings' windows. The panel header is now a prominent card with a Show categories / Hide button.

entries.title: Planning: product names under the Shoot Plan bar thumbnails
changes: Each product in the Shoot Plan bar is now named underneath its thumbnail (centred, at most two lines, full name on hover). Removal and everything else is unchanged.

entries.title: Planning: more prominent Shoot Plan selection bar
changes: The Shoot Plan bar under the Planning tabs is more prominent: a tinted card with a purple edge, a larger title and selected-count, larger product thumbnails (64px, was 40px) and a bigger View Shoot Plan button. Behaviour is unchanged.

entries.title: Core and High Stocks: Active Ads under the product name; Latest creative column
changes: In the Core and High Stocks tables, "N Active Ads" now sits under the product name, and the Creative coverage column is now "Latest creative": the date (for example 30 Sep 2026) with how long ago it was (for example 18 days ago) underneath. Unknown and None are unchanged.

entries.title: Dashboard: bigger shortcuts to Upcoming Drops, Promotions and Reference Library
changes: The Dashboard's Quick access cards are larger and now open Upcoming Drops, Promotions and Reference Library (replacing Creative Pipeline, Brief Builder and Creative Library). A card is hidden for a user whose access to that module is restricted.

entries.title: Dashboard: thicker weekly progress bar
changes: The Dashboard's weekly progress bar is twice as thick (16px instead of 8px); the shared progress bar used on other pages is unchanged.

entries.title: Final Approval creative preview, naming and destination; Editing three stages; one set of Concept Development actions
changes: Concept Development: the duplicate Creative Tools and + New Concept beside the New Concepts heading are gone; the page header's + New Concept now adds to the open product.

Editing: the status control shows three stages (Filmed, Editing, Approval) on one line with full labels; Booked is no longer a stage (editing days and scheduling are unchanged underneath); moving back from Editing keeps the editing day and edits, and Approval still goes back only through Request Changes in Final Approval.

Final Approval and Ad Setup show the finished creative (thumbnail, View creative link) and never substitute the product catalogue picture; a missing creative or an unpreviewable link shows a clear placeholder.

Ad Setup naming: Product Name no longer repeats the Product Category (whole-phrase split, structured category first); the Meta ad name keeps its structure and never repeats the category; product records are untouched.

Ad Setup destination: a single-product ad defaults to Product Page with the address resolved only from real data (Shopify product page, else an earlier Ad Setup of the same product), flagged when it cannot be found, never overwriting a saved choice; Final Check and Approve require a valid web address. Adds one nullable column, ad_setups.destination_defaulted_at.

entries.title: Planning thumbnails centred, tray remove, owner on New Concept, one-line status control
changes: Planning tray, Shoot Plan tiles and Upcoming Drops show one complete garment view centred by the garment itself (a same-origin, allow-listed picture route lets the browser measure it); the Upcoming Drops product page shows the whole picture, contained.
Every Planning tray thumbnail has a remove control (hover, keyboard focus, always visible on touch) that uses the guarded Shoot Plan removal: confirmation, protected concepts explained, history kept.
New Concept has an Assigned to field from the team list (default Mark), saved with the concept, shown on the card and editor, and changeable in the editor without resetting anything.
Concept editor section pills are centred and evenly spaced with the required-sections indicator and Show all kept readable; the layout switches to a compact arrangement by measured width.

Shooting (Scheduled, In production, Filmed) and Editing (Filmed, Scheduled, In editing, Awaiting approval) share one single-line status control that moves forwards and backwards through the existing endpoints, asks before leaving Filmed, and points to Final Approval for concepts already sent there.

entries.title: Planning: one garment view in thumbnails, full creative dates
changes: Planning tray and Shoot Plan tiles show ONE garment view: a labelled front picture is used whole, otherwise the front half of the front-and-back catalogue picture is shown, centred and scaled; both use one shared helper.
Creative coverage dates in Core and High Stocks now include the year (DD MMM YYYY), taken from the creative's own date; missing or impossible dates keep their placeholder.

entries.title: Shoot Plan: hide Drops-created entries recorded before v1.3.1
changes: Upcoming Drops assignments that were recorded before the last release no longer appear as Shoot Plan tiles or in the Planning selection tray; GET /shoot-plan now reports them as auto-linked.

entries.title: Planning: selection tray and simplified Shoot Plan
changes: Planning: a sticky selection tray under the tabs (Core, High Stocks, Creative Insights) shows the products added to the week's Shoot Plan, with thumbnails and View Shoot Plan.
Add to Shoot is one click and the product shows Added; selections persist per week and a repeat never duplicates.

The Shoot Plan page is now a grid of compact product tiles (only products explicitly added) with Confirm & Send Shoot Plan at the top right and a confirmation summary that does not submit anything for Tuesday Review.
Remove from plan archives untouched drafts and is refused, with an explanation, once a concept has work on it.
The old This Week's Shoot Plan panel, progress counters and Upcoming Drops auto-population are removed from Planning.

entries.title: UX, workflow and Final Approval refinement
changes: Kill Concept is now the single concept action on every production screen, works from any stage, and Move Back is on Shooting and Editing cards
Ad Setup: Product or Sale category, typed batch, automatic Creative Naming fields and URL page rules, no large generated-name panel; creative previews fall back to a labelled product image
Review creative (Ad Matching) redesigned as a fast two-column queue with a compact previous-match notice and evidence labels
Upcoming Drops alignment, larger progress checkboxes and configurable default Assigned To / Editing for new Required Concepts; Settings pages restyled to match Meta Performance
Copy library can be imported from CSV files when Google Sheets is not connected; clearer AI key diagnostics; read-only Meta auto sync status
Compact Shoot Plan summary and concept editor header; stage stepper on Shooting and Editing cards

entries.title: Tuesday Review fix, concept cleanup and WNDRR copy assistant
changes: Tuesday Review now lists only concepts explicitly submitted with Ready for Review; drafts stay in Concept Development (fixed on the server, review counts are genuine)

Archive Concept, Kill Concept and Remove Test Concept (admin) from one three-dot menu on Concept Development, Shooting, Editing, Final Approval and Ad Setup; history and Meta ads are never deleted, and every action is audited
Removing an empty promotion workspace no longer requires moving concepts back; unwanted Final Approval and Ad Setup drafts can be archived (nothing is deleted automatically)

Automatic Meta Headline, Description and CTA for standard, hype, live, mid-sale and last-chance ads, using the exact catalogue name and a verified promotion offer only; manual edits are never overwritten

WNDRR AI Copy Assistant for Primary Text: read-only Google Sheets copy library, tone statistics, three options, refinement and an explicit approval step (needs GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY)
Concept editor sections as tabs with completion markers, a more compact Shoot Plan summary, and one status vocabulary on Shooting and Editing

entries.title: Production workflow redesign
changes: New shared design system across Dashboard, Concept Development, Tuesday Review, Shooting, Editing and Final Approval: consistent headers, week selectors, summary tiles, filters, cards, status badges, empty states and modals
Dashboard rebuilt as weekly progress, production pipeline strip, needs-attention list and quick access, using real workflow counts

Final Approval and Ad Setup thumbnails are now the actual creative taken from the Final Edit link (video still with play icon, static image, one preview per version, clean placeholder when there is none)
Shoot Plan, New Concept, Concept editor and Ad Setup modals reorganised without removing fields or changing validation, naming, counting or workflow logic

entries.title: Active Ads, creative deduplication and Meta navigation
changes: Creative coverage now shows Active Ads (genuinely different creatives delivering now) with the latest creative date; Core and High Stocks share one table
Copies of one creative (Copy, Copy 2, Copy - Copy, with different Meta creative ids and no original in the set) now count once; each funnel keeps its own spend, purchases and CPA
View Meta Ads is one button that opens Meta Performance scoped to the product (all funnels and statuses, individual Meta ads, clearable, Back to Planning)
Recommendation thresholds, ranking, stock rules, benchmarks and Creative Insights are unchanged

entries.title: Core creative coverage
changes: Core table gains a Creative coverage column: unique creatives (duplicates and copies counted once) and the latest creative date from the ad names, Unknown when none is reliable
Row thumbnails are 62px and uncropped; the expanded product follows the new mockup with colourway cards (size availability) and one collapsed View Meta Ads section
Presentation only: engine, matching, benchmarks and Shoot Plan writes are unchanged

entries.title: Colourway thumbnails
changes: Core colourway thumbnails are larger and show the whole catalogue picture (front and back) uncropped; unavailable colourways stay recognisable
Presentation only: no data, selection or Shoot Plan changes

entries.title: Core planning simplified
changes: Planning Core is now a prioritised task list: a card header with priority summary, filters and tabs, and a table of Sales (30D) with 7D trend, Stock with weeks of cover, Creative gap, Priority and Action
Expanded product is short: Upcoming Drops picture, one sentence on why, three figures, selectable colourways, one Add to Shoot Plan action and a View Meta Ads link where relevant
The recommendation accordions and technical evidence are no longer shown in Core (still calculated, still in High Stocks)
Presentation only: engine, benchmarks, matching and Shoot Plan writes are unchanged

entries.title: Planning table refinement
changes: Sales 30D now shows a 7-day sales trend underneath (last 7 days vs the previous 7 days, from existing sales data)
Key metrics are flat and read across the row; rows are white with grey dividers and a light grey hover
Colour is limited to the trend, Creative status, priority dot and the primary action
Display only: recommendations, priority, creative status, filters, sorting and Shoot Plan are unchanged

entries.title: Last Creative Uploaded
changes: Core and High Stocks gain a Last creative metric: the newest creative date written in the ad names of each product's unique creatives
Original creative date is used for duplicated creatives; invalid, missing or conflicting dates show as unavailable, never guessed
Expanded product shows Last Creative Uploaded and Recent live ads shows each creative's original date beside its first delivery
Read-only display data: recommendation logic, classifications, creative effectiveness, matching, counts and Shoot Plan are unchanged

entries.title: Core planning redesign
changes: Core and High Stocks table redesigned: Key metrics, short coloured Creative status, Priority (Needs only) and Action columns
Weekly strip gains a thin weekly creative goal bar and View Shoot Plan link
Expanded product is now a decision panel: recommendation, three metric cards, compact colourway grid, three collapsible evidence sections
Presentation only: engine, matching, benchmarks, scoring and Shoot Plan writes are unchanged

entries.title: Planning refinements
changes: Creative age now follows the original unique creative: a duplicated Meta ad no longer restarts early testing (earliest delivery across every instance of the creative)

+ Add on every product row in Needs creative, Covered / monitoring and Needs review (black primary button, Actions column); stock-restricted colourways are never selected silently and need an explicit decision
Concise main-table assessments; counts, funnels, dates and evidence stay in the expanded row

entries.title: Creative Insights and shoot planning
changes: New Creative Insights section: concepts judged across all products and funnels (approved benchmarks, unique creatives), with suitable products to test and a + Add into the Shoot Plan

Creative age: 0 to 4 days early testing, from day 5 assessed (insufficient delivery); every creative assessed on its own and per funnel, so one new or unbenchmarked creative no longer dominates a product
Live ads shows only the unique-creative number; Priority only in Needs creative (sortable); quick + Add; one concept covers several colourways; concept chooser in the Shoot Plan modal
Fixes: priority vs slow-stock contradiction, one stock-coverage calculation, part-period sales no longer qualify as steady demand

entries.title: Planning recommendation accuracy and Live ads
changes: Needs Creative now requires 40 available sellable units in a shootable colourway, real sales velocity runway and worthwhile demand; incoming stock never counts
Platinum/Rocket tiers and steady or strong launch sales qualify demand; weak-demand and stock-restricted products are hidden but their assessment is kept
Creative conditions measured from first delivery with named missing benchmarks; unsupported performance claims removed
Live ads column restored on Core and High Stocks: unique creatives, delivery window setting, per-creative detail table
Colourway section and choice when adding to the Shoot Plan; accurate thumbnails; three visible categories; top navigation synced with the sidebar; Planning settings section

entries.title: Planning experience redesign
changes: Planning has its own sidebar sub-menu: Core, High Stocks and Shoot Plan
Core and High Stocks share one simpler page: four status groups, a five-column table and plain-English reasons
Expanded products show the recommendation, key facts, suggested direction and production activity, with detailed evidence kept behind one click
Production progress now lives on the Shoot Plan page
WNDRR favicon is served at /favicon.ico and the browser tab is titled WNDRR Creative

entries.title: Planning intelligence and Meta lookup safety
changes: Planning: Core, High Stocks and a new Protect Momentum view are compact sortable tables; recommendations judge real current demand, stock cover, season and creative evidence, and explain themselves
Recent launches are judged on sales per day on sale; High priority for a launch needs strong demand
Unidentified Meta ads are weighed by their share of spend instead of suppressing recommendations
Meta lookups no longer use the multi-id request Meta removes on 27 Oct 2026; failures are recorded, bounded and never treated as deleted

entries.title: Reference Library redesign
changes: Visual-first Reference Library: large previews on every card, with a cleaner four-column grid, compact header, and month headings with a divider
Previews come from an uploaded cover image first, then an automatic preview fetched from the link (YouTube, TikTok, page image); a failed preview never blocks saving
Cards open a viewer with the larger preview, full comment and original link; Edit and Delete moved into the three-dot menu

entries.title: Update Requests page
changes: New Update Requests page above Settings where anyone can ask for an app change or report a UX issue, with a priority (P1 Critical to P4 Low) and pasted or attached screenshots and PDFs
Everyone sees every request; the person who raised it, or an admin, can edit, resolve, reopen or delete it
Open and Resolved lists, and an open count on the sidebar item

entries.title: Best Ads calendar fixed
changes: The Best Ads date range calendar now opens fully in view, left-aligned under its button, instead of running off the left edge over the sidebar
The popover is also clamped on the left edge as well as the right at any window width
The last-updated text in the header can no longer run under Refresh now

entries.title: Date range popover clean-up
changes: The date range calendar is tidier: compact preset list, evenly sized month and year selectors, matching From / to date fields that no longer spill out, and the popover now always stays inside the window.

entries.title: Meta Performance header, KPI row and filters redesign
changes: Meta Performance: the navigation is centred, the date range and Previous period moved into the Ad Performance filters (Date range, Funnel, Status, Campaign, Search ads; Previous period, Include DPAs and the DPA note below).

The summary is now ten compact cards in one row (Frequency stays in the table), and the funnel selection narrows the summary cards as well as the table. Outbound CTR changes are shown in percentage points.

entries.title: Red-only benchmarks
changes: Benchmarks can now be red only: highlight just the ads that miss a target (beyond the tolerance you choose) and leave everything else uncoloured.

entries.title: More benchmark measures
changes: Purchase Value, Adds to Cart and Cost / ATC can now be benchmarked per funnel, so every measure in the table except Amount Spent and Purchases can be highlighted.

entries.title: Green-only benchmarks
changes: Benchmarks can now be green only: highlight a value green when it meets a threshold (for example Reach of 20,000 or more) and leave it uncoloured otherwise, with no orange or red.

entries.title: Benchmarks are optional
changes: Performance Benchmarks: any benchmark can be cleared back to unset (a Clear link on the card and in the editor), and a target of 0 is no longer accepted.

entries.title: Performance Benchmarks redesign
changes: Settings → Meta Performance → Performance Benchmarks is redesigned: a colour guide, one section per funnel (TOF, TOM, MOF) with six benchmark cards each, and a right-hand editor with a live colour preview.

Set or edit a target from its card; several reporting windows per measure are shown together in the card. Change history is now a collapsed section at the bottom. All existing benchmarks, rules and history are unchanged.

entries.title: Funnel checkboxes and per-funnel benchmarks
changes: Performance: the Funnel dropdown is replaced by TOF / TOM / MOF checkboxes (all selected by default, Select all, n of 3 selected) that filter the ad table only; the summary cards keep their scope.

Benchmarks are now set separately for each funnel and measure (CPA, ROAS, Outbound CTR, CPM, Reach, Frequency, with an optional Frequency range); each ad is coloured only against its own funnel's benchmark, and unset measures stay uncoloured.

entries.title: Performance & Best Ads refinement
changes: Performance: 20 ads per page with numbered pagination and a visible total; search now covers ad name, Meta Ad ID, product and concept across the whole dataset.
Best Ads now shows unique creatives: Meta ads whose names differ only by trailing Copy suffixes are grouped into one card with combined Purchase Value, Purchases, Amount Spent, CPA and ROAS.
Clicking a creative shows its performance by funnel (TOF / TOM / MOF) and every underlying Meta ad, each with its own preview.

entries.title: Best Ads page
changes: Meta Performance now has a Best Ads page: a gallery of the best-performing Meta ads ranked by purchase value, with Rank By, Funnel, Campaign, Status, Minimum Spend, Search and Include DPAs filters.
Meta Performance in the sidebar expands to Performance, Best Ads and Ad Matching; the date range and Previous period carry across pages.
Each card is one Meta ad with its real creative, Purchase Value, Purchases, CPA, Reach, Amount Spent and ROAS, and opens the existing Ad Preview.

entries.title: Meta ad preview: redesigned two-column modal
changes: The ad preview now shows the real Meta preview on the left (with Meta preview / In-app player switch and an asset strip when Meta gives several assets) and Ad Details, Performance and Links & Actions on the right.
Meta Ad ID and the full ad name can be copied; Refresh Preview refreshes only the preview.
Dynamic creative now has a short note instead of a warning panel.

entries.title: Meta Performance: clearer KPI comparisons, ad names, row hover
changes: KPI cards compare with the previous period (one decimal, favourable or unfavourable only where it is clear; Reach and Frequency show unavailable).
Ad names are slightly smaller, semibold, two lines at most.
Hovering a row now lightly highlights the whole row without losing the column shading.

entries.title: Version tracking begins
changes: The version now shows at the bottom of the sidebar; click it to see this history.
Starting point for numbering. Earlier work was not versioned one change at a time; it is included here.
Planning: Core, High Stocks and the Shoot Plan with a weekly target of 15 new concepts; the Weekly Plan is retired.
Meta Performance: new layout with KPI panels, previous-period comparisons, a date range picker, DPA exclusion, and real creative previews.
The WNDRR wordmark in the sidebar now takes you to the Dashboard.
